title: 第394章 活口值钱第393章 中州接头人
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
那个青面男子被带进了城主府的地下药室里。
药室的四周并没什么刑具，就只有十二排药柜，还有一张用来诊治神魂伤势的石床。
枯荣让所有不相干的人都退了出去，屋里只留下了林天、韩立、朱有福和李清雪他们几个。
那个驼背老头被关在了隔壁。
两个人就不能碰面，也听不见对方在说些什么。
枯荣先是检查起了死魂印。
那道印记就藏在识海的最底下，外面还包着三层的假魂纹。
要是按照普通的禁制来处理，拆掉第一层的时候，就会直接引爆真正的核心。
这个青面男子刚才自己主动催动过一次，核心上已经有了裂痕，要是再来一下，他肯定会死。
“名字。”
林天问。
男子躺在石床上，沉默了一会儿，才说：“严九。”
“真名呢？”
“进了天机阁之后，真名这东西就没什么用了。”
林天也就没再追问他的本名。
“北庄那边是谁在负责？”
严九的喉结动了一下，他识海里的死魂印马上就亮了起来。
枯荣手快，一针就落了下去，把那道波动给压住了。
“别直接问人名，”他开口说道，“这印会跟着他的念头一起发动的。”
朱有福就问：“这玩意儿还能知道他心里想说啥？”

“具体的它不知道，但是能判断出来他是不是在泄露那些被封存的消息。像是职位、地点、阵法还有上级的姓名，都可能会发动它。”
“那要怎么问？”
枯荣拿出六根颜色不一样的木签，放在了严九的手边。
“让他自己选。”
第一组木签代表的是人数。
五十人以下、五十到一百人、一百人以上。
严九选了第二根。
第二组是代表修为最高的。
金丹、灵府、法相。
他选的是灵府。
第三组代表的是庄子里的用途。
收人、验血、下钉、转运、炼丹。
严九先后选了验血、下钉、转运，炼丹那个没选。
这么看来，北庄不是主炉，也不是什么分炉，而是一个用来处理中转“药材”的前置据点。
林天接着换了个问题。
“庄子里有转移阵吗？”
严九点了点头。
“能直接通到天都吗？”
摇头。
“是通到中州的其他药庄？”
content_en:
The green-faced man was taken into the underground medicine room of the city lord's palace.
There were no torture instruments around the medicine room, only twelve rows of medicine cabinets and a stone bed used to diagnose and treat the soul's injuries.
Kurong asked all the irrelevant people to leave, leaving only Lin Tian, ​​Han Li, Zhu Youfu and Li Qingxue in the room.
The hunchbacked old man was locked up next door.
Two people cannot meet each other and cannot hear what the other person is saying.
Kurong first checked the dead soul seal.
That mark is hidden at the bottom of the sea of ​​​​consciousness, and it is also covered with three layers of fake soul patterns.
If it were handled according to ordinary restrictions, when the first layer was removed, the real core would be detonated directly.
This green-faced man had just taken the initiative to activate it once, and there were already cracks in his core. If he did it again, he would definitely die.
"Name."
Lin Tian asked.
The man lay on the stone bed and was silent for a while before saying, "Yan Jiu."
"Where's your real name?"
"After entering Tianji Pavilion, the real name is of no use."
Lin Tian didn't ask for his real name anymore.
"Who is in charge over at Beizhuang?"
Yan Jiu's Adam's apple moved, and the death soul mark in his consciousness immediately lit up.
Ku Rong's hands were quick and he dropped the needle in one stroke, suppressing the wave.
"Don't ask the person's name directly," he said, "the seal will be activated along with his thoughts."
Zhu Youfu asked: "Can this thing know what he wants to say in his heart?"
"It doesn't know the details, but it can tell whether he is leaking sealed information. Such as position, location, formation, and the name of his superior, it may be activated."
"Then how should I ask?"
Kurong took out six wooden sticks of different colors and placed them in Yan Jiu's hand.
"Let him choose."
The first set of wooden signs represents the number of people.
Fifty people or less, fifty to a hundred people, more than a hundred people.
Yan Jiu chose the second one.
The second group represents those with the highest cultivation level.
Jindan, Lingfu, Dharma.
He chose Lingfu.
The third group represents the uses in Zhuangzi.
Recruiting people, testing blood, placing nails, transporting people, and refining elixirs.
Yan Jiu chose the blood test, nailing, and transshipment, but did not choose the alchemy one.
From this point of view, Beizhuang is not the main furnace, nor is it a branch furnace, but a front-end stronghold for processing "medicinal materials" in transit.
Lin Tian then changed the question.
"Is there a transfer array in Zhuangzi?"
Yan Jiu nodded.
"Can we get directly to Tiandu?"
Shake his head.
"Is it the other medicine store in Zhongzhou?"
